article.title: -아/어야 하다 obligación
article.part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태
article.chapter: Deseo, obligación, permiso y capacidad — 희망·의무·허가·능력

claims.summary: The NIKL guide distinguishes obligation use of **-어야 하다/되다** from the separate connective ending **-어야** (“only if”). This entry is limited to the obligation construction and its documented forms; the source does not imply one fixed source of obligation.
